key_insight: MOTIF improves out-of-distribution materials property prediction by using LLM-generated taxonomies to guide invariant feature selection, rather than using LLMs as numerical predictors.
engineering_relevance: The framework can improve prediction robustness for unfamiliar material chemistries, supporting screening beyond the training distribution.
method: Generate candidate chemically meaningful material taxonomies with LLMs.
Retain taxonomies that improve training-only pseudo-OOD validation.
Apply invariant feature selection within each accepted taxonomy and combine predictions through gated aggregation.
evidence_signal: On 2D halide perovskites, mean OOD bandgap MAE fell from 0.122 to 0.111 eV; frozen dev/test evaluation also showed smaller improvements for electronic and optical bandgaps, with transfer evaluated on additional materials datasets.
watch_item: Deployment requires leakage-free taxonomy selection and validation that pseudo-OOD gains transfer to the intended chemistry shift.
paper_title: MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
